address: Bond Street Hotel, 350 Oxford Street, London,W1C 1BY
bio: Blending contemporary details and classic wood-panelled interiors, Bond St. Tea Rooms sets itself apart with a twist on the traditional British Afternoon Tea.  Begin your experience with a selection of Italian cicchetti, such as a Bruschetta of yellowfin tuna tartare, followed by classic finger sandwiches with Mediterranean influences, homemade scones and deliciously indulgent Italian desserts. The experience is of course complemented with your tea of choice and an optional addition of Champagne or prosecco.  Located just off Oxford Street and directly opposite Bond Street Station, Bond St. Tea Rooms is the perfect treat when visiting London for the day or shopping at nearby boutiques on Oxford Street, New Bond Street and department stores such as Selfridges.  Winter Afternoon Tea is served from Thursday to Sunday, 1pm-5pm.
